value.answer: In Oakville, Ontario, there's no open Costco yet. The one being built is on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, and it's targeted to open in fall 2027. Burlington already has one, though I couldn't find its address. A deals site says the Laird Rd location in Mississauga serves Oakville too, but I couldn't confirm that.
